title: Living Ecosystem
description: Living ecosystem plugin with realistic animal and plant life cycles.
body:
# Living Ecosystem
Create a truly living world with realistic life cycles for animals and plants.

## Features
- Animals mature over time (baby to adult)
- Natural reproduction between mature animals
- Natural death after configurable lifespan
- Species-specific lifespans (cow, sheep, pig, chicken, horse, rabbit)
- Plant life cycle phases:
  - `BLOOM`: faster crop growth, flower spread, plant revival
  - `STABLE`: normal behavior
  - `WITHER`: crop decay and flower withering

## Commands
- `/ecosystem status [world]`
- `/ecosystem reload`

## Configuration Highlights
- Animal maturity timing
- Reproduction chance, cooldown, and radius
- Per-species lifespans and death chances
- Plant cycle day lengths (bloom/stable/wither)
- Bloom and wither behavior rates

## Compatibility
- Minecraft `1.16.5` -> `1.21.11`
- `Paper`, `Spigot`, `Bukkit`, `Purpur`, `Folia`
